research_question: Does previously blocked, directly observed JPX D-1 activity information improve a leakage-safe pre-open stock ranker or a fixed cash veto relative to a price-only daily-rank Ridge control?

authority.reason: VALIDATION Entry 004 records 2025-08-04 through 2026-07-21 as already consumed or previously viewed. This experiment can test whether the newly available exact activity channel deserves a separately locked forward shadow, but it cannot establish production performance.

prior_work_binding.previous_status: blocked because the historical monthly JPX source had no usable volume, turnover, VWAP, or trading-unit fields
prior_work_binding.new_source: official JPX daily stock quotation PDFs parsed by jpx_daily_text_v6_special_quote_marker
prior_work_binding.fixed_cost_interpretation: 20, 40, and 60 basis points are sensitivity haircuts, not measured execution costs

price_warmup.purpose: D-1-or-earlier price history only; monthly rows have no liquidity values and are never filled

selection_daily.failure_rule: A missing file, unexpected file, hash mismatch, non-daily source format, parser rejection, or date-set mismatch aborts the whole three-candidate family. Missing data are never replaced with price proxies.

locked_replay_daily.execution_rule: Only one selection-gate passer and its capacity-matched control may be replayed after a separate remote winner lock. If no variant passes, these PDFs are not opened by this experiment.

point_in_time_contract.latest_predictor_source: the immediately preceding completed official session
point_in_time_contract.target_outcome_use: Labels and open-to-close returns are joined to an already hashed score ledger by date and code.
point_in_time_contract.missing_source_rule: Missing is not zero and does not become no-event. A source-contract failure aborts the family; an individual security without 20 consecutive valid daily observations is ineligible.
point_in_time_contract.official_no_trade_rule: An official zero-volume or zero-turnover observation is real data, not missing, but fails the positive-activity candidate eligibility rule.
point_in_time_contract.cash_rule: A fixed top-one or top-two slot that is ineligible or lacks an observed target outcome stays cash with zero gross return and zero cost. No lower-ranked replacement is allowed.
point_in_time_contract.tie_break: Higher score, then security code ascending.

exact_liquidity_features.history_rule: Twenty consecutive official daily rows ending D-1; every row must have strictly positive volume, turnover, VWAP, trading unit, and close, and trading unit must be unchanged across the window.

features.name: liq_turnover_med20
features.formula: median turnover over D-20 through D-1

features.name: liq_volume_med20
features.formula: median volume over D-20 through D-1

features.name: liq_turnover_log_iqr20
features.formula: IQR of log1p(turnover) over D-20 through D-1

features.name: liq_close_vwap_abs_med20
features.formula: median(abs(close / vwap - 1)) over D-20 through D-1

exact_liquidity_features.model_transform: For every score date and feature, average-tie percentile rank across the strictly prior, history-complete universe, mapped to [-1, 1].
exact_liquidity_features.vwap_limit: Close relative to actual VWAP is an observed location statistic and is not described as spread or slippage.

control.objective: 2 * same-date percentile rank of realised training open-to-close return - 1
control.matched_universe: The control and all three candidates require the same price eligibility and complete 20-session exact-activity history. C00 uses activity availability only, never an activity value. LQ01 and LQ03 apply their additional fixed veto after their top-two slots are fixed.
control.missing_value_rule: Price-feature missing values use the existing training-fold median plus missing indicator. Exact-liquidity fields are never imputed; incomplete 20-session activity history is ineligible.
control.fit_schedule: monthly expanding; labels end at the last official session of the preceding month; no mid-month refit

candidates.mechanism: Apply a hard, directly observed D-1 activity veto to the already fixed C00 top-two slots.
Test the incremental predictive value of seven directly observed activity features.
candidates.features: common_price_features plus seven exact-liquidity percentile-rank features
candidates.missing_value_rule: Price-feature missing values use the existing training-fold median plus missing indicator. Every exact-liquidity feature must be observed after the 20-session fail-closed rule.
candidates.fit_schedule: monthly expanding; labels end at the last official session of the preceding month; no mid-month refit

candidates.mechanism: Test a deterministic D-1 close-versus-VWAP reversal strengthened by actual turnover shock.
candidates.activity_veto: same three fixed thresholds as LQ01

evaluation.family_member_rule: Every candidate-capacity pair remains in the family even if all-cash, failed, or sequence-identical.
evaluation.winner_rule: If no variant passes every gate, reject all candidates and do not open the replay PDFs. Otherwise choose maximum familywise paired lower bound, then maximum top-four-days-removed net40, then variant id ascending.
evaluation.locked_replay_rule: A separate remote lock must bind the one winner recipe and capacity before replay input is opened. Replay performance cannot change the selected family, capacity, features, thresholds, or parameters.

required_tests: same-day OHLC, volume, turnover, VWAP, and trading-unit mutation leaves same-day predictors, eligibility, scores, and codes unchanged
future-row mutation leaves all earlier scores unchanged
row shuffle leaves semantic score output unchanged
a nonconsecutive or nonpositive 20-day activity history fails closed
trading-unit change fails closed for 20 sessions
vetoed and missing-outcome slots stay cash without replacement
score ledger contains no outcome and is hashed before outcome join
monthly training maximum date precedes every score month
production and order authority remain false
stop_rule: Run the six registered selection variants once after this protocol, runner, and tests are remotely committed. Do not add variants or change any source, feature, threshold, parameter, cost, capacity, gate, or tie-break after reading selection returns.
